item.name: Get the combined LPC/LPP view of every known device

request.description:
Returns one entry per device that participates in LPC (Limitation of Power Consumption) and/or LPP (Limitation of Power Production), covering both the devices the hub simulates and the external (real) devices it observes as Energy Guard. A device that runs both use cases appears once with both sections filled.

The controllable-system state (Init, Limited, Failsafe, ...) is only present for simulated devices: it is a hub-internal state machine that is not propagated over the EEBUS protocol and therefore cannot be known for an external device.

Changes to any of this data are announced on the event stream as the `LpcLppViewUpdate` event.

request.description:
Returns one entry per unique SHIP connection (identified by the canonical
sorted pair of SKIs). Two local entities that are connected to each other
(e.g. an EVSE and a HEMS running in the same hub) are deduplicated into a
single row. Imported log sessions without lifecycle callbacks are also
deduplicated by their SPINE device-address pair, so mirrored A→B and B→A
frames appear as one connection. `isActive` is set when SPINE data frames
have been observed on the connection; `state` reflects lifecycle
transitions when present, and historical/imported sessions with no
lifecycle state are reported as disconnected.
